# Colecto v0.5.1

A new logo, menus that no longer shift the app, dialogs that close when you click
outside them, and desktop notifications that can be turned on in the Linux app.

## New logo

- **A new mark.** The Colecto symbol is now a C wrapped around a paper plane. It
  appears on the app icon on every platform, in the window and browser tab, on the
  startup screen and in the top bar.

## Menus and dialogs

- **Menus stay in place.** Opening a menu with too little room below it, such as the
  pane arrange menu in a short window, used to scroll the whole workspace out of place.
  Menus now open on whichever side has more room and fit the space available. When
  neither side has enough room, the menu is cut off and the app stays where it is.
- **Click outside to close.** Every dialog, including account settings, AI replies, the
  label editor and the extension install warning, now closes when you click the dimmed
  background, just as Escape does. Unsaved account changes still ask before they are
  discarded.

## Notifications

- **Desktop notifications work in the Linux app.** Turning on Settings → Notifications →
  Desktop notifications always failed with "Your system blocked notifications for
  Colecto", even though nothing had been blocked. The app now grants that permission
  itself, so notifications reach your desktop's notification service. On Windows, the
  extra permission prompt is gone. The Android app still can't show desktop
  notifications; in-app notifications work everywhere.
